topic: Periodic table and chemical behavior prediction
key_concepts: Elements on the periodic table are arranged by groups and periods
Rightmost periodic table elements are nonmetals; leftmost are metals
Metalloids have metallic appearance but can behave like nonmetals
Metals show luster, malleability, ductility, and conductivity
Noble gases neither give nor receive electrons under normal conditions
Hydrogen is the only nonmetal in the alkali group
Halogens are known as salt formers
Electron configuration can help determine an element's properties and periodic table locat
Metal reactivity with acids varies by group; alkali metals are highly reactive
Gold, silver, and platinum resist tarnishing because of low reactivity
Electron affinity, ionization energy, and metallic character follow periodic trends
Metals that lose one valence electron tend to react faster than those losing two
